title: Benelli & CFMOTO & KOVE Benelli TNT 600i Inline-4 (Dark Edition)
description: Representing CFMOTO's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the CFMOTO Benelli & CFMOTO & KOVE Benelli TNT 600i Inline-4 (Dark Edition) is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. A 600cc powerplant pumps out 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
